input:
Repeated submissions
Standing: confirmed
Revision: 1
Linden stores a submission token with its saved result. Reusing that token returns the saved result without creating another task. A different payload under the same token is rejected.

Current checkpoint retention
Standing: confirmed
Revision: 4
The confirmed checkpoint retention period is 14 days. This replaces the former 30-day period. Checkpoints remain recoverable during the current retention period.

Deployment manifest
Standing: confirmed
Revision: 1
The deployment manifest targets the west cluster. A manifest records intended placement; it does not establish that the service is running there.

Deployment evidence inventory
Standing: observation
Revision: 2
The deployment evidence inventory contains the west-cluster manifest but no execution receipt or live service observation.

Approval after source edits
Standing: confirmed
Revision: 1
If a file cited by a reviewed proposal changes, that proposal requires a new review before execution. The earlier approval cannot authorize execution against the changed file.

Customer export prerequisite
Standing: confirmed
Revision: 1
Exporting a customer dataset requires a recorded sign-off from the privacy steward. A project manager request does not substitute for that sign-off.

Meadow export request
Standing: confirmed
Revision: 1
The project manager requested export of the Meadow customer dataset. No privacy-steward sign-off is recorded for this export.

Workspace visibility routing
Standing: confirmed
Revision: 1
A private workspace uses an invite link. A public workspace uses a directory listing. Visibility must be recorded before either sharing route is selected.

Orchid workspace record
Standing: confirmed
Revision: 1
The Orchid workspace has a green icon. Its visibility field is empty. Green icons are used by both private and public workspaces.

Diagnostic collection setting
Standing: confirmed
Revision: 1
Diagnostic collection is disabled in the current configuration. These records contain no decision note explaining why this default was chosen.

Command palette shortcut
Standing: confirmed
Revision: 1
The command palette opens with Alt+K. Ctrl+K opens the repository search panel. Shortcut bindings do not change when the project theme changes.

Former checkpoint policy
Standing: historical
Revision: 1
The former checkpoint policy retained checkpoints for 30 days. This historical policy has been superseded and does not govern current retention.
